environment: Node built-in test runner; minimal DOM, injected JSON-RPC and wallet transport in process; real bundled ethers ABI/hash encoding and decoding
coverage: Null deployment stays visibly awaiting deployment with disabled writes and no wallet/RPC requests
Read-only auto-load and explicit load decode actual ethers ABI tuples including the Snapshot.values Array-method collision
Raw eth_chainId verifies the actual read RPC even when getNetwork/staticNetwork advertises4663
All three runtime code hashes, immutable Reports dependencies, chain, numeric model and training manifest pins must match
All four action calldata encodings bind reviewed identifiers or source code hash; wallet values remain zero
Fresh45-second quote binds wallet, both chain IDs, action and context; exact BigInt reserve, explicit consent and full accepted budget required
A hash-null recovery intent containing owner/chain/target/calldata hash/nonce/gas/fee/budget is durably stored and read back before the wallet prompt
Returned transaction hash is durably stored before receipt waiting; unavailable or silently dropping storage blocks submission
Ambiguous wallet errors and interrupted receipt reads block every subsequent send, including after a simulated reload
Reconciliation checks sender, target, nonce, chain, zero value, exact calldata/selector and requested/returned transaction/receipt hashes
Absent/noncanonical receipts and unavailable or zero effective fees/gas usage preserve pending recovery
Account/chain changes or expiry during nonce lookup stop submission; fee/gas growth, context changes, block limit and balance are rechecked
Corrupt or unreadable saved journals fail closed rather than becoming approval for a new wallet transaction
Quoted estimated fee includes a 10 percent submission gas price margin rounded up; fresh submission uses live spot plus that margin capped by the accepted fee ceiling and reserve
A 0.05 percent spot increase and near-ceiling spot cases submit with headroom without exceeding the reviewed reserve; chosen submission price is durable before the wallet prompt
reviewFindingsResolved: A durable hash-null intent and explicit nonce now precede wallet submission, preserving unknown-outcome recovery
Actual RPC chain is checked independently of a static provider network declaration
Unsafe storage failure or corrupt recovery records block writes
Final wallet identity and quote expiry are checked after nonce lookup
Quote matching checks the quote chain as well as the current wallet chain
Returned hashes and nonzero actual receipt fee information must verify before clearing recovery
Submission gas price includes 10 percent headroom to tolerate minimum/basefee drift, capped by the existing accepted fee ceiling; visible estimated fee includes the same margin
limits: These are deterministic semantic mocks, not browser-extension or funded-wallet QA; real browser and deployment verification are separate
The single-action fee limit is a browser guard; a wallet can alter transaction parameters and confirmed overruns must be reported
No mainnet deployment, funded inference or public transaction was performed by this suite
